u: Expects /proc/cpuinfo data on stdin and converts it to cpuid-like HEX data structure suitable as the input for cpuid -f <file> utility. Alternatively, user can specify CPU vendor, family, model and stepping on the command line.

<dl><dt data-o="">-help</dt><dd>Displays a brief help message.</dd><dt data-o="">-vendor</dt><dd>CPU vendor. Can be either GenuineIntel or AuthenticAMD.</dd><dt data-o="">-family</dt><dd>CPU family in decimal notation.</dd><dt data-o="">-model</dt><dd>CPU model in decimal notation.</dd><dt data-o="">-stepping</dt><dd>CPU stepping in decimal notation.</dd><dt data-o="">-help</dt><dd>Displays a brief help message.</dd></dl>
Only Intel & AMD cpuinfo data are supported at the moment.

cpuinfo2cpuid < /proc/cpuinfo | cpuid -f - | grep '(synth)'

Specifying CPU vendor, family, model and stepping on command line

cpuinfo2cpuid.pl -vendor=GenuineIntel -family=6 -model=58 -stepping=9 | cpuid -f - | grep '(synth)'
